dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures in the mid-dorsal region feature jagged, high-contrast perimeters with a steep gradient from dark exterior fur to light grey interior; perimeter geometry is irregularly elliptical with non-uniform edge thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters localized in the interstitial gaps between macro-annuli, particularly concentrated along the superior spinal axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary configuration of four smaller posterior annuli forms an irregular quadrilateral along the lateral midline.
